turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on past questions with did?
turns.tutor:
You know words like yesterday and last weekend. First, the past form.
Look: Today I walk to school. Yesterday I walked to school.
Rule: for a finished action, add -ed to most verbs.
Right: Yesterday I cleaned my room. Wrong: Yesterday I clean my room.
Now you try. Write the past form: Last night Sam ___ (cook) dinner.
